item.description:
Volna 1.0.6

  • No more quitting after a headset disconnects. When a Bluetooth headset went away and the Mac switched to another microphone, the next dictation could make Volna quit unexpectedly a moment later. Volna now records from the microphone as it is at that moment, and if the Mac's sound system still refuses, it reports the microphone as unavailable instead of quitting.
